claims.claim: US Treasury's Iran sanctions campaign threatens mid-tier Chinese banks
claims.reason: S1 says the Treasury actions (proposed cutoff of an Emirati bank, sanctions on Turkey's Golden Global bank) 'establish a potential template for targeting mid-tier Chinese banks linked to Iranian oil sales in the future'. That supports 'threatens' as a risk. S1 also says the August round spared significant Chinese banks.

S2 says China is 'tightening scrutiny of capital outflows' and has increased checks on overseas investment, effective September 15. S3 says the package tightens scrutiny of outbound tech-linked investment. S3 also notes the $50,000 personal FX cap was left unchanged, so this was tighter scrutiny rather than a lower cap.

claims.claim: PBOC steadied the yuan before the Trump-Xi summit
claims.reason: The only source that may cover this, S4 (Bloomberg), could not be retrieved, so there is no text to check. S6 also could not be retrieved. S5 only says, looking ahead, that 'PBOC policy action ... could limit yuan depreciation'; it does not say the PBOC actually acted to steady the yuan.

claims.claim: The Trump-Xi summit was on 24 September
claims.reason: S5 states 'The Trump–Xi summit on 24 September'. S1 is consistent: Xi arrives Wednesday and talks are on Thursday.
